issue_context.title: TileMap layers above 0 aren't loaded
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

73668c5

### System information

W10

### Issue description

When you have a TileMap with more than 1 layer, the additional layers are lost upon loading the scene. The layers are correctly saved in the scene, so it's some loading issue.

It's regression from #52277

### Steps to reproduce

1. Add TileMap
2. Add 1 or more additional layers
3. Save and reload the scene

### Minimal reproduction project

_No response_

review_comments: You also need to call `notify_property_list_changed()` as it changes the list of properties exposed by the TileMap.
